name: react-doctor-loop
description: Continuously turn confirmed React Doctor benchmark false positives into validated draft pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Fix audited false positives with Codex
interface.longDescription: A single Codex-native loop for auditing one root-cause cohort, implementing the narrow fix, proving it against the benchmark and open-source corpus, and opening a review-only draft pull request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $react-doctor-loop to fix the next confirmed false-positive cohort.
